description: Queries `GET /v1/proof/{hash}` to check the Bitcoin settlement status (Block Height, Block UTC Time, Bitcoin TXID, Merkle Root, and Merkle Inclusion Path) of an anchored hash. Optionally saves or updates the finalized `.json` Doomsday Proof receipt AND/OR generates the 4-Plate Sovereign Cryptographic Provenance Certificate HTML on demand.

file_path.description: Optional local file path corresponding to the anchored hash (used to verify local custody/Passkey ownership and populate exact file name, size, and MIME type on the Provenance Certificate).

hash.description: The 64-character client_hash or t_index to verify.

open_certificate_in_browser.description: If true, generates the 4-Plate Sovereign Cryptographic Provenance Certificate HTML and opens it in the system browser.

output_certificate_html_path.description: Optional custom file path to save the 4-Plate Provenance Certificate HTML.

output_json_path.description: Optional local file path to save the settled JSON Doomsday Proof receipt.

save_certificate_html.description: If true, generates and saves the 4-Plate Sovereign Cryptographic Provenance Certificate (`reltime-certificate-<name>.html`) on demand.

name: reltime_check_proof
